_comment: Hand-maintained entries merged into public/firmware-manifest.json by scripts/generate-firmware-manifest.mjs (extra wins on id clash). Use for devices whose firmware Logitech only ships outside versioned depots, or values confirmed against vendor software. Prefer generated entries whenever a depot exists. Versions here are in device-reported (entity) numbering, e.g. HID++ MPM 38.00, which G HUB displays as package 38.0.5 — see releaseNotes. Receiver entries are deliberately absent: HID++ 1.0 register 0xF1 was proven (pre/post-flash identical bytes) to report per-MCU bootloader identifiers, not app versions, so no honest version verdict exists yet. See docs/logitech-firmware-handoff.md.

devices.releaseNotes: Entity MPM 38.00 == package 38.0.5, confirmed current in G HUB on 2026-10-09.
